name: synthetic-week
title: A synthetic week
description: One week of half-hourly flows and pressures, exit-point nominations and bookings generated from the network model, with an unplanned outage at Kollsnes, reduced capacity on Langeled, recurring H2S and CO2 excursions at four fields, random pressure and flow limit breaches and a pigging programme on every trunk, export line and interconnector. Synthetic: use it to see how live operations look, not as a record of real flows.
source: Generated by nora.stream.synthesize from data/nodes.csv and data/pipelines.csv
